description_en: Queries the list of node group configuration refresh tasks by paging
description_zh: 分页查询节点组配置刷新任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun eflo-controller list-node-group-refresh-tasks --cluster-id i118191731740041623425 --node-group-id ng-3525 --statuses Success --next-token 563d42ae0b17572449ec8c97f7f66069 --max-results 20 --api-version 2022-12-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodeGroupRefreshTasks

parameters.help_en:
The list of task statuses. Valid values:
Pending: The refresh task is created and waiting to be executed.
InProgress: The refresh task is being processed.
Success: The refresh task is executed.
Failed: The refresh task failed
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态列表：
Pending 刷新任务创建成功，等待执行
InProgress 刷新任务正在处理中
Success 刷新任务执行成功
Failed 刷新任务执行失败
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的 NextToken 参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数，取值范围：1~500。默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 单页查询的最大条目数
MaxResults.title_zh: 单页查询的最大条目数。

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. If NextToken is empty, no more results exist
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的 Token，NextToken 为空表示没有下一个
NextToken.title_zh: 下一个查询开始的 Token，NextToken 为空表示没有下一个。

NodeGroupRefreshTasks.description_en: The list of node group refresh tasks

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the refresh task in ISO 8601 format

FinishedCount.description_en: The number of finished nodes, including succeeded, failed, and skipped nodes
FinishedCount.description_zh: 已完成节点数(包括成功、失败、跳过的)
FinishedCount.title_zh: 已完成节点数(包括成功、失败、跳过的)

MaxDisruptiveAction.description_en: The maximum disruptive action level allowed for the refresh operation
MaxDisruptiveAction.description_zh: 刷新操作允许的最大破坏性操作等级
MaxDisruptiveAction.title_zh: 刷新操作允许的最大破坏性操作等级

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the refresh task in ISO 8601 format

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
Pending: The refresh task is created and waiting to be executed.
InProgress: The refresh task is being processed.
Success: The refresh task is executed.
Failed: The refresh task failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态：
Pending 刷新任务创建成功，等待执行
InProgress 刷新任务正在处理中
Success 刷新任务执行成功
Failed 刷新任务执行失败
